_comment: 2026 has no official key. Every row was compared with an independent second derivation (blind/2026-Mathematics/second.json) on 2026-10-30: 16/16 MCQ letters and 36/38 written answers agree. The two that differ are settled below; the published solution is the main derivation's in both.

adjudications.why: Paper defect: (1, 2) is not on x^2 = 4y. The main solution solves it as printed (2x + y - 4 = 0) and tells the student the intended point is likely (2, 1), giving x + y - 3 = 0; the second solver answered the intended version. Kept as printed, per the solve-as-printed rule.

(iii) main 16/37 vs second 21/37. 'Did not plant today' = it rained today, so P(R1 | R2) = 0.32/0.74 = 16/37. The second solver computed P(no rain today | rain tomorrow), which answers a different question. Main derivation kept.
